Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class PlantSharedResourceParticipantSample

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.PlantSharedResourceParticipantSample
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PlantSharedResourceParticipantSample>
public final class PlantSharedResourceParticipantSample extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<PlantSharedResourceParticipantSample>
Immutable observation for one participant in a shared plant-resource constraint.

Values retain the participant's declared source unit and basis. Conversion to the shared target is performed only by PlantSharedResourceEvidence using the conversion registered in PlantConstraintParticipant. Missing observations are represented by status and Double.NaN; they are never converted to zero. An explicit zero is accepted only as a finite PlantSharedResourceParticipantSample.Status.AVAILABLE observation or as PlantSharedResourceParticipantSample.Status.OUT_OF_SERVICE evidence.
